# Lantern Works

> Cited prices for AI agent infrastructure: GPU rental rates, scraping, proxies, email and search APIs, ranked by price for the buyer among tracked providers, not the whole market.

## Data
- [GPU prices (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/gpu-prices.json): per-row rate, tier, source_url, verified_at, availability
- [Deals feed (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/deals.json)
- [Stack pricing (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/stack-pricing.json)
- [For agents](https://thelanternworks.com/for-agents/): endpoints, record shape, MCP server

## Availability rule
- A stock claim (availability.in_stock true or false) is valid for 8 hours: until availability.availability_expires_at (checked_at + 8 h, UTC). After that, treat it as unknown, neither in stock nor sold out.
- availability.in_stock null means no signal, not sold out.
- Pages show the same limit as "valid until HH:MM ET; after that treat as unknown".
